user.title: Set up Solar Savings
user.description: Choose the sensors used to calculate cumulative solar savings. Energy sensors should be kWh counters. Price sensors should expose the current import or export price per kWh in your configured currency. The accounting interval is expressed in seconds: accumulated energy is valued once per interval, and also whenever an import or export tariff changes, using the tariff that applied before the change. Use 0 to value energy on every sensor update. Without the optional battery section, self-consumption is the generated energy that was not exported, so no imported-energy sensor is needed.

battery.name: Battery tracking (optional)
battery.description: Select all three sensors to also account for a home battery, or leave them all empty. With them, the integration compares what you actually paid against two hypothetical houses: one with the panels but no battery, and one with neither. That splits the savings into a solar and a battery part, and no longer assumes that everything the meter exported came from the panels.

init.title: Configure Solar Savings
init.description: Update the sensors used to calculate cumulative solar savings. The accounting interval is expressed in seconds: accumulated energy is valued once per interval, and also whenever an import or export tariff changes, using the tariff that applied before the change. Use 0 to value energy on every sensor update. Adding or removing the optional battery sensors changes which savings sensors this entry publishes.

set_value.name: Set stored value
set_value.description: Overwrites the stored cumulative total of a Solar Savings sensor, for example to initialise savings from a previous system, or to correct accumulated drift.

value.name: Value
value.description: The new cumulative total: an amount in the configured currency for the monetary sensors, or kWh for the virtual energy meters.
